newsitem.title: LATVIA: CENTRAL BANK TO START SWAP OPERATIONS.
newsitem.headline: CENTRAL BANK TO START SWAP OPERATIONS.

text.p: The central bank said on Monday that it is to launch operations with swaps from July 1, which it said would take place according to bank demand.
A bank spoksman said that the swaps be in lats and dollars and would help the bank better to control the flow of money and allows banks to cooperate freely with the central bank.

"The currency swap deals will help the further development of the Latvian money market, giving banks the chance to borrow in lats for a certain period, without carrying out currency conversions and lowering the exchange rate risk," the bank said in a statement.
Any bank with a correspondent account with the central bank can take part in the swap auctions, the spokesman added.
